metadata.title: PoShKeePass
metadata.description: PoShKeePass is a PowerShell module that combines the ease of the PowerShell cli and the extensibility of the KeePassLib API to provide a powerful and easy to use management and automating platform for KeePass databases.

findings.title: Plain text is converted to a secure string
findings.description: File 'file-00003.psm1' uses ConvertTo-SecureString with plaintext. This will expose secure information. Encrypted standard strings should be used instead.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'New-KeePassEntry' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
